features.name: Write Births and Conceptions Log to Text File
features.description: Keeps a plain-text log of the village's conceptions and births in 'Virtual Villagers 2 Births and Conceptions Log <n>.txt', in the 'Virtual Villagers Fun Patcher Logs\Births and Conceptions' folder beside the game's saves (Documents\LDW\<game executable name>\). Each Conception record gives both parents' names, both parents' ages at conception, both head and body values, both parents' likes and dislikes, and the number of babies; the mother's age determines the child's age. Each Birth record gives the child's name, head, body, likes, dislikes and skills, and its mother's and father's names, heads and bodies. A new numbered file is started after every 256 Conception records; Birth records go into the file holding the latest conceptions and do not count toward that limit. The game keeps both parents on the child's own record, and each Birth record reads them from there. VV2 keeps the father's name on the mother's record and no father id; his head and body are copied onto her at conception, so the log reads them from her record and they stay correct even after he dies or another villager takes his name. His age, which has no copy on her, is read from his own record -- every caller that holds it passes it, the Love Note included -- so a normal birth records his real age. **Runs on the Origins-exclusive base, which is installed automatically with it and adds the Origins Upgrades buttons to the Tech and Villager Details screens**: the loader trampoline lives in the page that base appends, because VV2's own code cave is occupied by the renamed-build crash guard and has no room for it.

needs_on.for: the village and savegame header at the top of the log, and for creating the log at a village's first save -- a new village, or one restarted with Start Over -- before anything is recorded (without it, records are still written correctly, just unlabelled, and the log first appears with its first record -- unless Cause of Death is ticked, which names the village at each save itself)

vv2_enable_origins_exclusive_features.purpose: Retarget the conception routine's rejection exit to a relocated one-pop stub, so the success join stops being reachable one byte in and can be diverted whole
Divert the single point where every successful conception converges and the litter size is final, into the loader trampoline
The loader trampoline, the relocated one-pop rejection stub, and the companion and export name strings
The birth hook: a shared body that resolves WriteParentageBirth once and hands it the game id and the new child's record, the companion and export name strings, and one stub per child-creation site
Divert the first child of every birth into its birth stub, which calls the companion, replays these seven bytes and returns to 0x43be9a
Divert the twin into its birth stub, which calls the companion, replays these seven bytes and returns to 0x43beeb
Divert the triplet into its birth stub, which calls the companion, replays these seven bytes and returns to 0x43bf37
